section.title: Toolbar
section.para:
This dialogue enables you to change the items displayed on either the Main Toolbar or the Status Toolbar.
The initial display shows the current setup. You may re-order these items by right-clicking on any item.
Additional items may be included by clicking on the "Plus" symbol at the bottom of the tab. A list of all available options is displayed.
Most of the Geeqie menu items are available. The Plugins submenu lists enabled plugins for both the Main Toolbar and the Status Toolbar.

note.para: Plugin icons may be theme names or absolute file paths. A generic icon is used when no icon is specified or a theme icon cannot be found. The desktop file format is described in the Standards section
